name: Somchai Srisawat
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for racing, fueled by late-night viewings of MotoGP and Formula 1 with his grandfather. He studied marketing at Chulalongkorn University, focusing on digital strategies and brand management. After graduating, he interned at a local karting track, helping them boost their social media presence and organize events. 

He joined Century Motorsport seeking to blend his passion for racing with his marketing expertise. Somchai believes in data-driven marketing and constantly seeks new ways to engage fans and sponsors. His proactive approach involves analyzing market trends, developing engaging content, and fostering strong relationships with media outlets. He aims to elevate Century Motorsport's brand image both locally and internationally.

What makes Somchai stand out is his ability to bridge the gap between technical jargon and everyday language. He can translate complex engineering concepts into relatable stories, making the sport more accessible to a wider audience. This skill, combined with his unwavering loyalty and creative flair, makes him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build and a warm, friendly smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
Starts every morning with a strong Thai iced coffee.
